subject: salamander
fact: A salamander coils around Zephyr, scalding through his cloth and crushing his ribs.
source_quote: One moment I was moving — I am always moving, that is the entire trade — and the next there were coils around me, scalding through the cloth, and the only question left was whether I could tear free before it decided what to do with me.

subject: salamander
fact: A salamander throws a fire bolt that goes wide of Calmer.
source_quote: the salamander's first thrown bolt went wide of him, and the second went wider still.

subject: salamander
fact: A salamander is killed by Zinnia with one blow.
source_quote: He picked the wounded one and went straight through it — slap, slap, slap, the whole drumroll — and it simply stopped existing.

subject: salamander
fact: A salamander kneels and sets its flaming spear down on the stone.
source_quote: It stopped. It knelt. It set its flaming spear down on the stone.

subject: salamander
fact: The last salamander shrugs off Calmer's death-knell bell.
source_quote: The last salamander shrugged it off.

subject: salamander
fact: The salamander that surrendered points at the fire pit to indicate the treasure is theirs.
source_quote: The creature stood, pointed at the fire pit.

subject: salamander
fact: The salamander that surrendered is named Vorkal by Frostbrand.
source_quote: It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr reads a contract offered by the salamander and strikes out clauses involving soul and ownership.
source_quote: He read it through, top to bottom, and I watched his eyes stop on the clauses near the end, the ones written to take more than service. The ones that buy a piece of the signer along with his signature. He struck them out.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr cuts himself and signs the contract with the salamander.
source_quote: Zephyr cut himself and signed.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shakes hands with the salamander despite the fire that will burn him.
source_quote: He took it anyway. "I will die sooner," he said, and closed his hand around the salamander's.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tells Calmer he is going too deep in his deception.
source_quote: "I think you're going in too deep."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia says Calmer is not a real cleric of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: "You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tells Calmer he understands the art of spying.
source_quote: He said I understood the art of spying, that if I told him he was going too deep, he would believe me.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia volunteers to open the chest and avoids a blade trap.
source_quote: Sequoia volunteered — a thief's hands, faster than the trap. Calmer chose the moment before the lock to demand we start calling him the Prophet, the Prophet Calmer, the Prophet of the Earth Temple. Sequoia opened the box. A blade cut the air where his throat would have been and found nothing — his hands had already moved him clear.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia reads the magical sword and finds no useful information.
source_quote: I bent close and gave it everything I had. "Not much," I said. What I came away with was nothing useful and one fact I did not like.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia asks for a glove to handle the cold sword but receives none.
source_quote: "Could I have a glove?" Nobody handed me a glove. "Can I get a glove?" Still nothing.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia flips the chest over to let the sword fall out.
source_quote: What if I just flip the chest over? Let it fall out.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia takes the cold sword into his hand and survives its chill.
source_quote: I let it down into my actual hand, against my better judgment, and the cold sat there and did not kill me.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia names the sword Frostbrand after it speaks.
source_quote: Frostbrand. "How long have you been in that box?" A very long time, it said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia tells Frostbrand they are on an undercover mission.
source_quote: "We're kind of on an undercover mission right now," I said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia confirms to Frostbrand that they killed Romag and let the temple war eat itself.
source_quote: We killed Romag. Ran a three-way war and let it eat itself. I have taken things when no one was counting. That is the file.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is chosen by Frostbrand as the sword's wielder.
source_quote: It looked at Zinnia. A possibility. It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer, and for one long second I thought it had found its man — and instead it came back to me. "You, you are exactly what I was looking for."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia agrees to take Frostbrand and says he is already holding it.
source_quote: They got around to me. "Sorry — what?" Take the sword, they said. "I will." Then, because it was already true: "Already holding it."

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer demands to be called the Prophet of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Calmer chose the moment before the lock to demand we start calling him the Prophet, the Prophet Calmer, the Prophet of the Earth Temple.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer asks Zinnia for judgment on forming an alliance with a Fire Temple creature.
source_quote: "Zinnia, what do you think?" he said. "I trust your judgment on these things."

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is named St. Cuthbert's by Frostbrand in the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer scrambles after being named St. Cuthbert's by Frostbrand.
source_quote: Calmer scrambled.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer approves of Zephyr opening the secret door.
source_quote: The secret door opened north, and Zephyr volunteered to do the opening, which I approved of.

subject: Vorkal
fact: Vorkal, the salamander, rolls his eyes during Frostbrand's speech.
source_quote: Vorkal watched the whole speech and rolled his eyes, looking more bored than I would have thought a salamander could manage.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple contains a fire pit where the salamander guarded treasure.
source_quote: The salamander stopped fighting. It knelt. It set its weapon down — point to the floor, both hands open. ... The creature stood, pointed at the fire pit.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple contains a chamber with red and orange tapestries, torchlight on lacquered wood, cushions, low tables, stools, and a throne with a gold skull on the back.
source_quote: The chamber beyond was a hot, bright thing — reds and oranges and yellows, torchlight on lacquered wood, tapestries celebrating the triumph of elemental fire across every wall. Cushions, low tables, stools. And one chair. A huge wooden seat, red and gilt, with a gold skull leering off the back.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple has a secret door opening north.
source_quote: The secret door opened north, and Zephyr volunteered to do the opening.

subject: flaming spear
fact: A salamander sets its flaming spear down on the stone.
source_quote: It set its flaming spear down on the stone.

subject: two potions
fact: Two potions that promise to turn flame aside are found in the chest.
source_quote: Inside: two potions that promised to turn flame aside.

subject: ring
fact: A ring that turns flame aside is found in the chest.
source_quote: A ring that did the same.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a cold magical sword found in a fire pit.
source_quote: And one more — a sword, cold to the touch, wrong in this room full of heat.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand coughs when lifted from the chest.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand speaks to Vorkal in the language of salamanders.
source_quote: It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand says it has been in the box since Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand asks if any of the party are good.
source_quote: Then it asked whether any of us were good.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand points at Zephyr, Zinnia, Sequoia, and Calmer to judge their alignment.
source_quote: It pointed at Zephyr first. ... It looked at Zinnia. ... It looked at me. ... And then it looked at Calmer.

subject: Emridy Meadows
fact: Frostbrand was taken as a trophy from Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Alrrem
fact: Frostbrand asks where Alrrem is.
source_quote: Then it stopped and asked where Alrrem was, and who I was.

subject: St. Cuthbert's
fact: St. Cuthbert's is a name that is a death sentence in the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Zephyr signing the contract
fact: Zephyr signs a contract with the salamander after cutting himself.
source_quote: Zephyr cut himself and signed.

subject: Zephyr shaking hands with the salamander
fact: Zephyr shakes hands with the salamander despite the fire burning him.
source_quote: He took it anyway. "I will die sooner," he said, and closed his hand around the salamander's.

subject: Sequoia opening the chest
fact: Sequoia opens the chest and avoids a blade trap.
source_quote: Sequoia opened the box. A blade cut the air where his throat would have been and found nothing — his hands had already moved him clear.

subject: Frostbrand speaking
fact: Frostbrand speaks aloud and identifies itself as sentient.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Frostbrand choosing Sequoia
fact: Frostbrand chooses Sequoia as its wielder.
source_quote: It looked at Zinnia. A possibility. It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer, and for one long second I thought it had found its man — and instead it came back to me. "You, you are exactly what I was looking for."

subject: Sequoia taking Frostbrand
fact: Sequoia takes Frostbrand into his hand and survives its cold.
source_quote: I let it down into my actual hand, against my better judgment, and the cold sat there and did not kill me.

subject: Calmer being named St. Cuthbert's
fact: Frostbrand names Calmer as St. Cuthbert's in the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Zephyr confronting the Fire Temple commander
fact: Zephyr tells the Fire Temple commander they have come to finish the job.
source_quote: "Yes," said Zephyr.

subject: Emridy Meadows
fact: Frostbrand was taken as a trophy from Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer declares himself Chief Cleric of the Obsidian Edge.
source_quote: I let it be known that there had been a recent readjustment of the supreme leadership of the Upper Temple, and that I was now in charge. "Yes, yes," I went on, "the Obsidian Edge and the Chief Cleric is myself, Calmer."

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer names Dren Halveth as the supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces.
source_quote: And these are my loyal henchmen, and you will, of course, be subordinate to Dren Halveth, who is the commander, supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth is named as the supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces by Calmer.
source_quote: And these are my loyal henchmen, and you will, of course, be subordinate to Dren Halveth, who is the commander, supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr demands two gold coins from the commander in exchange for sparing his life.
source_quote: "Two gold coins for sparing your life, please."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells the commander, "I will not forget this."
source_quote: "I will not forget this," Zephyr told him.

subject: Commander
fact: The commander responds to Zephyr by saying, "Nor will I."
source_quote: "Nor will I," said the commander.

subject: Commander
fact: The commander hands over two gold coins to Zephyr.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells Calmer, "Now we are leaders," after being called an assassin.
source_quote: "I thought you were an assassin!" "Now we are leaders," I told him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells the fire cleric, "You could be our subordinate, or you could leave the temple."
source_quote: "If you want to leave the temple, we'll allow you to do so. If you want to stay, you must be my subordinate."

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer corrects Zephyr by saying, "Our subordinate," when referring to the fire cleric's status.
source_quote: "Our subordinate," Calmer corrected.

subject: Fire Cleric
fact: The fire cleric says, "I never really liked Alrrem."
source_quote: "You know, I never really liked Alrrem."

subject: Alrrem
fact: Alrrem is referenced as a deceased fire cleric whom the fire cleric disowns.
source_quote: "You know, I never really liked Alrrem."

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer asks if there are any more clerics of fire still alive.
source_quote: Calmer asked if there were any more clerics of fire still alive.

subject: Fire Cleric
fact: The fire cleric confirms there are no more clerics of fire alive.
source_quote: "No."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr names the fire cleric as the new Head Cleric.
source_quote: "Alright. You're head Cleric," I said, releasing her and brushing a cushion's worth of dust off my sleeve.

subject: Fire Temple Chamber
fact: The Fire Temple chamber contains rugs over rugs, tapestries on every wall, candelabra, plush furniture, cushions piled like someone planned a nap, tables of nuts and sweetmeats, and a scarlet robe tucked under pillows.
source_quote: The chamber was the nicest thing I'd seen since we walked into this place, and that is its own kind of insult. Rugs over rugs, tapestries on every wall, candelabra throwing warm light over plush furniture and cushions piled like someone had been planning a very expensive nap. Tables of nuts and sweetmeats. A scarlet robe tucked under the pillows.

subject: Fire Temple Chamber
fact: The Fire Temple chamber is decorated in bright scarlet, hot orange, and fiery gold.
source_quote: Bright scarlet and hot orange and fiery gold everywhere, the colors of people who had never once worried about a bill.

subject: Fire Temple Chamber
fact: The Fire Temple chamber's ceiling is plastered and painted with demons and humans doing ambitious things to each other.
source_quote: The ceiling was plastered and painted with demons and humans doing things to each other that I would describe as ambitious.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple has slabs of polished azurite and malachite flooring.
source_quote: Slabs of polished azurite and malachite, blue swirled through deep green,

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple's floor emits a soft cloudy greenish light.
source_quote: and some old magic seeping a soft cloudy greenish light up out of the very floor,

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple smells of brine.
source_quote: Even the damp smells of brine.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple has a great bronze bas-relief on the west wall depicting an underwater vista with seaweed, shells, and a fish-head spewing water.
source_quote: There is a great sheet of bronze on the west wall — a bas-relief, an underwater vista, seaweed and shells and a hideous fish-head with its maw spewing a stream of water down four tiered basins,

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple's altar is round, broad as a wagon, waist-high, with a concave top that is a shallow basin.
source_quote: And the altar: round, broad as a wagon and waist-high, its concave top a shallow basin,

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple's altar basin contains coins, gems, and gems, and seashells.
source_quote: and in that water, gentlemen, *coins.* Gems. Seashells. A whole drowned fortune sitting there waiting.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple has a serpentine idol in an alcove, taller than a man, composed of knotted eels, octopi, and fish.
source_quote: South of it, in an alcove, a serpentine idol of writhing marine horrors, eels and octopi and fish all knotted into one obscene mass, taller than a man and then some.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple has four pillars, each crowned with a stone gargoyle.
source_quote: And four pillars, each crowned with a stone gargoyle.

subject: scarlet robe
fact: A scarlet robe is tucked under the pillows in the Fire Temple chamber.
source_quote: A scarlet robe tucked under the pillows.

subject: two gold coins
fact: The commander hands over two gold coins to Zephyr as payment for sparing his life.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: dagger
fact: The fire cleric draws a dagger when questioned by Zephyr.
source_quote: She didn't answer. She went for her dagger.

subject: bronze bas-relief
fact: Zephyr knocks on the bronze bas-relief in the Water Temple, triggering its magic.
source_quote: He knocked on it.

subject: gargoyle
fact: Four stone gargoyles crown the pillars in the Water Temple and animate as hostile creatures.
source_quote: And four pillars, each crowned with a stone gargoyle. ... the gargoyles came off their pillars. Wings unfolding. Stone going from stone to *intent.*

subject: gargoyle
fact: Zephyr strikes the first gargoyle with his dagger, inflicting a deep wound.
source_quote: Zephyr had the first word and put his dagger into the gargoyle beside him — a real bite, the kind that takes a chunk and leaves a creature reconsidering its existence.

subject: gargoyle
fact: Sequoia carves into one of the gargoyles deeply before stepping back.
source_quote: Sequoia carved into his own, deep, then stepped back out of reach.

subject: gargoyle
fact: Calmer destroys the first gargoyle with radiant spirits, reducing it to nothing.
source_quote: The first gargoyle nearest the spirits simply ended — there one instant, gone the next, the light tearing it apart before it understood what had arrived.

subject: gargoyle
fact: Calmer's radiant spirits gnaw down the second gargoyle, reducing it to half its size.
source_quote: The second buckled, the radiance gnawing it down, its movement gone to mud.

subject: gargoyle
fact: The third gargoyle is slowed and torn down to half its size by Calmer's radiant spirits.
source_quote: And I kept walking — over here, over here — and the third caught the edge of the wheel and staggered, slowed, sloughing stone, torn down to half of what it had been.

subject: Calmer claiming leadership
fact: Calmer declares himself Chief Cleric of the Upper Temple after a readjustment of leadership.
source_quote: I let it be known that there had been a recent readjustment of the supreme leadership of the Upper Temple, and that I was now in charge.

subject: Zephyr demanding gold
fact: Zephyr demands two gold coins from the commander as payment for sparing his life.
source_quote: "Two gold coins for sparing your life, please."

subject: commander surrendering gold
fact: The commander hands over two gold coins to Zephyr, trembling like a man tipping an executioner.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: fire cleric being subdued
fact: Zephyr, Zinnia, and Sequoia perform a group hug to subdue the fire cleric and pin her dagger.
source_quote: Four of us crossed the lavish little room and converged on her like long-lost cousins. I got there first, and I got there *perfectly* — arms locked, weight set, the grab landing so clean it almost made me laugh. Then Zinnia folded in behind me, the second hold sliding home off the first, smooth as a closing drawer. Sequoia ducked under and pinned the legs.

subject: fire cleric becoming head cleric
fact: Zephyr names the fire cleric as the new Head Cleric after her surrender.
source_quote: "Alright. You're head Cleric," I said, releasing her and brushing a cushion's worth of dust off my sleeve.

subject: gargoyles animating
fact: The gargoyles in the Water Temple animate and detach from their pillars after Zephyr knocks on the bronze bas-relief.
source_quote: The idol began to rotate. ... and then, because the day deserved a little flourish, the gargoyles came off their pillars. Wings unfolding. Stone going from stone to *intent.*

subject: Calmer using radiant spirits
fact: Calmer invokes radiant spirits to destroy three gargoyles in the Water Temple.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits. They came the way they always come for me, that wheeling radiant guard of them, and I walked into the hall *with* them, the way a man walks into his own house. The first gargoyle ... simply ended ... The second buckled ... the third caught the edge of the wheel and staggered, slowed, sloughing stone, torn down to half of what it had been.

subject: Zinnia warning Calmer
fact: Zinnia warns Calmer not to overreach into a room he does not yet own.
source_quote: Zinnia told me — calm, spy-quiet, the way he does it — not to go too deep. To not overreach into a room I did not yet own.

subject: Prophet Calmer
fact: Calmer has been turning the title 'Prophet Calmer' over in his mind all session.
source_quote: Chief Cleric. Loyal henchmen. Subordinate to Dren. The whole hierarchy laid out clean as a writ, and the commander nodding along like a man signing a confession he hasn't read. ... Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, *Prophet Calmer* —

subject: St. Cuthbert's teaching
fact: Calmer attributes the principle 'Authority abhors ambiguity' to St. Cuthbert, though he is unsure if he learned it from him or invented it in his name.
source_quote: Authority abhors ambiguity — St. Cuthbert taught me that, or I taught it to myself in his name, the line has gotten difficult to draw.

subject: session
fact: Calmer has been turning the title 'Prophet Calmer' over in his mind all session.
source_quote: Chief Cleric. Loyal henchmen. Subordinate to Dren. The whole hierarchy laid out clean as a writ, and the commander nodding along like a man signing a confession he hasn't read. ... Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, *Prophet Calmer* —

subject: Earth Temple Forces
fact: Dren Halveth is the supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces.
source_quote: And these are my loyal henchmen, and you will, of course, be subordinate to Dren Halveth, who is the commander, supreme commander of the Earth Temple Forces.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is a religious order whose clerics worship fire and are now being subjugated by the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Chief Cleric is a fine thing to say in a room full of someone else's fire-worship and someone else's broken throne,

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is a sacred site with magical architecture and a drowned fortune, now claimed by Calmer and his party.
source_quote: The Water Temple is a beautiful thing, and I hate that it is beautiful. Slabs of polished azurite and malachite, blue swirled through deep green, and some old magic seeping a soft cloudy greenish light up out of the very floor,
